title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3 (Europe/Australia, PAL)
required_inputs: ported BT3 sound-init bypass override (SJX_Init E0100302 'can't create DTX'): applyBt3SoundInitBypass in game_overrides.cpp replaces hardcoded USA guest addresses and is registered for SLUS_216.78 only
ported BT3 DTX URPC + sceMpeg + NULL packet-list overrides (same, USA-keyed)
the 14 stub bindings transfer_symbols.py cannot re-base unambiguously
notes: The boot ELF, its 7-program VU1 manifest and 167 of 181 recompiler stub bindings are derived for this serial. It boots, initialises video and the kernel, and reaches DMA/GIF activity, then stops in the SJX/SVM sound middleware's SJX_Init with E0100302 'can't create DTX' -- the IOP sound subsystem is stubbed and the override that lets USA fall through is registered for SLUS_216.78 with hardcoded USA guest addresses. Not playable.
